description: This file defines a custom Akka Mailbox implementation named `ThingPersistenceActorMailbox`. It manages message queuing for actors that handle `ThingModifyCommand`s, imposing a capacity limit to reject commands when overloaded. The mailbox uses a deque to prioritize or enqueue messages and provides custom behavior for specific message types.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox
classes.description: Custom mailbox type for handling `ThingModifyCommand`s with capacity limitation, used in Akka actor systems to manage message flow and reject excessive modification requests.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActorMessageQueue
classes.description: A specialized message queue extending LinkedBlockingDeque that enforces capacity limits for modification commands and logs warnings when limits are exceeded.

methods.name: ThingPersistenceActorMailbox
methods.description: Constructor called by Akka to initialize the mailbox with system settings and configuration, particularly the capacity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a new message queue instance.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Returns the underlying deque used as the message queue.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a message, applying capacity logic for `ThingModifyCommand`s.

methods.name: enqueueFirst
methods.description: Enqueues a message at the front of the queue, applying capacity logic for `ThingModifyCommand`s.

methods.name: queueSizeBasedAction
methods.description: Performs capacity check; if exceeded, sends an error response; otherwise, runs the given enqueue action.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the head of the queue.

methods.name: numberOfMessages
methods.description: Returns the current number of messages in the queue.

methods.name: hasMessages
methods.description: Checks if the queue has any messages.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Forwards all queued messages to deadLetters when the mailbox is cleaned up.
